name: B10-0175/2026 (ECR) – Human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals, in particular from Africa, for Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals, in particular from Africa, for Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Russia for tricking and forcing people from other countries, especially Africa and Cuba, to fight in its war against Ukraine. It says recruits were promised jobs, education or residency, then had documents taken and faced threats. It asks affected governments to shut down local recruitment networks and bar citizens from working for Russia. It also calls for the end of the EU's cooperation agreement with Cuba.

- The EU is asked to end its cooperation agreement with Cuba over Cuban fighters.
- Affected governments are urged to break up recruitment networks and ban work for Russia.
- The Parliament only states positions; it does not itself change any law.
